Hi all — quick technical read:

- BYOK coverage: our platform supports customer-managed KMS keys for data-at-rest on model storage in Dedicated and Private modes today. Hosted mode (standard managed clusters) does not yet support customer KMS for model blobs; we have an ongoing project to extend this. For pilot with MedSpring, we can deploy a Dedicated pool scoped to their account to meet BYOK requirements.
- Key rotation: rotation is supported but requires a brief reshard/metadata update step. Impact window: ~30s per node for KV-metadata rollover; in-flight tokenization calls should continue but may see transient 5–10s latency spikes during a rotation if requests hit a node actively rotating keys. We can coordinate rotations to low-traffic windows; a rolling rotation minimizes impact.
- Audit logs export: we have an export job that writes compressed JSON lines to S3. 365-day tier export is feasible; throughput depends on log volume. For pilot, recommend incremental export (weekly deltas) rather than full dump.

Estimated effort to enable BYOK in Hosted (not Dedicated) for model blobs: 6–8 weeks (engineering + security review). For Dedicated-based pilot, we can deliver within 2 weeks if infra capacity is available and legal signs off on contract language.

I'll draft a short technical summary for Naomi to send.

—Karthik
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference

Couple of ops notes:

- Export safety: we should snapshot logs at the ingress point to avoid partial records during live rotation. That means a short quiesce window (~2–3 mins) if they want a consistent contiguous slice. If MedSpring accepts eventual consistency for the export (we produce monotonically increasing deltas) we can avoid any quiesce.
- Rotation runbook: I can produce a zero-downtime playbook but it requires 30m of scheduled coordination (notify nets/devs, throttle new long-running jobs).
- Storage cost: 365-day retention at their projected QPS looks like ~1.2TB/mo compressed; we should surface cost estimates.

I'll prepare the ops runbook and the cost estimate by EOD.

Ben Carter
Senior Ops Engineer, Redwood Inference

Hi Alice, Naomi and team — thanks for the details. Naomi, tagging the response items below so we can respond to MedSpring with one coordinated note: 

- Scope: For the pilot we can offer Dedicated deployment (BYOK + encrypted audit logs) scoped to MedSpring. That meets their BYOK ask immediately without Hosted changes.
- Rotation expectations: we will include a documented rotation runbook and schedule rotations outside of MedSpring's business hours. The runbook will call out the potential 5–10s latency blip per affected node and mitigation steps.
- Exports & retention: we can support a 365-day retention tier and periodic S3 exports. We'll provide an incremental export mechanism (weekly deltas) and one full snapshot on request (requires a ~2–3 min quiesce for consistency).
- Exceptions: temporary policy carveouts (e.g., allowing S3 exports to a MedSpring-managed bucket during the pilot) require: a written request from the customer, approval from Compliance (Naomi), and a signed addendum from Legal.
- Next steps: Naomi to send a non-committal pilot summary to Alice with: (1) our proposed Dedicated scope and timeline, (2) the ops runbook and cost estimate (Ben), (3) the BYOK technical note (Karthik), and (4) the list of permissions/Docs we need from MedSpring (Alice: target S3 bucket, contact for key admin).

I'll also add this checklist to the pilot intake board and tag Legal for the addendum template.

Marissa Cole
